name: en_fr_word_translation
description: Translate a common English noun/adjective into French in a few-shot list format. Control: same few-shot format but the line asks to repeat the English word (copy).
generator_code:
import random, json
random.seed(0)
pairs = {"dog":"chien","cat":"chat","house":"maison","water":"eau","bread":"pain","book":"livre","car":"voiture","tree":"arbre","sun":"soleil","moon":"lune","sea":"mer","city":"ville","friend":"ami","night":"nuit","day":"jour","red":"rouge","green":"vert","black":"noir","white":"blanc","small":"petit","big":"grand","door":"porte","window":"fenêtre","table":"table","chair":"chaise","apple":"pomme","milk":"lait","cheese":"fromage","fish":"poisson","bird":"oiseau","horse":"cheval","flower":"fleur","river":"rivière","mountain":"montagne","school":"école","street":"rue","king":"roi","queen":"reine","child":"enfant","woman":"femme","man":"homme","hand":"main","head":"tête","heart":"cœur","eye":"œil","love":"amour","time":"temps","world":"monde","life":"vie","sky":"ciel","snow":"neige","rain":"pluie","wind":"vent","fire":"feu","earth":"terre","money":"argent","work":"travail","village":"village","forest":"forêt","garden":"jardin","kitchen":"cuisine","bed":"lit","shoe":"chaussure","hat":"chapeau","egg":"œuf","salt":"sel","sugar":"sucre","wine":"vin","beer":"bière","boat":"bateau","train":"train","road":"route","island":"île","country":"pays","week":"semaine","year":"année","morning":"matin","evening":"soir","song":"chanson","language":"langue","teacher":"professeur","doctor":"médecin","key":"clé","cup":"tasse","knife":"couteau","star":"étoile","blue":"bleu","old":"vieux","new":"nouveau"}
words=list(pairs)
def make(ctrl):
    out=[]
    for w in words:
        shots=random.sample([x for x in words if x!=w],3)
        if ctrl:
            p="".join(f"English: {s}\nRepeat: {s}\n" for s in shots)+f"English: {w}\nRepeat:"
            a=" "+w
        else:
            p="".join(f"English: {s}\nFrench: {pairs[s]}\n" for s in shots)+f"English: {w}\nFrench:"
            a=" "+pairs[w]
        out.append({"prompt":p,"answer":a})
    return out
json.dump({"items":make(False),"control":make(True)},open("/work/skill.json","w"))
